question: How do we track conversions on the location finder without a Fresh Blends style redirect hop?
answer: Keep the finder URL as the only ad destination. Install the Replenish Google tag on that page. Mark get_directions as the primary conversion. Do not add a Netlify hop.

staleComingCopy: hero locpin: Now in San Diego County · South Florida coming soon
locator.js Florida region status: Coming this August
footer: Now in San Diego County, CA · South Florida coming this August
each Florida /locations/ page: Coming soon / Coming this August

requiredProgrammerWork: Add the Replenish Google tag (GA4 and or Google Ads) to the finder page and every /locations/ page.
Keep the existing get_directions fire with store_id.
Keep gclid gbraid wbraid and UTM persistence.
requiredAdsWork: Import or create get_directions as a primary conversion in the Replenish Google Ads account only.
Point every in-scope campaign final URL at https://7eleven.getreplenish.com.
qa: Land on https://7eleven.getreplenish.com with gclid present.
Click Get Directions on one store.
Confirm the Google tag fires get_directions with that store_id.
Confirm Google Ads records the conversion after the usual delay.
doNotUse: Any Kwik Trip Ice Box redirect hop
